mapper.select: SELECT strategy_id, active_rebalancing, trigger_by_threshold, trigger_by_periodic, frequency, execution_time, max_adjustment_rate, stock_deviation, bond_deviation, commodity_deviation, cash_deviation, update_time FROM strategy_rebalance_config WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_rebalance_config (strategy_id, active_rebalancing, trigger_by_threshold, trigger_by_periodic, frequency, execution_time, max_adjustment_rate, stock_deviation, bond_deviation, commodity_deviation, cash_deviation, update_time) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{activeRebalancing}, #{triggerByThreshold}, #{triggerByPeriodic}, #{frequency}, #{executionTime}, #{maxAdjustmentRate}, #{stockDeviation}, #{bondDeviation}, #{commodityDeviation}, #{cashDeviation}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active_rebalancing = VALUES(active_rebalancing), trigger_by_threshold = VALUES(trigger_by_threshold), trigger_by_periodic = VALUES(trigger_by_periodic), frequency = VALUES(frequency), execution_time = VALUES(execution_time), max_adjustment_rate = VALUES(max_adjustment_rate), stock_deviation = VALUES(stock_deviation), bond_deviation = VALUES(bond_deviation), commodity_deviation = VALUES(commodity_deviation), cash_deviation = VALUES(cash_deviation), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
